evidence.description: Report number 24-055426. Date of incident Monday, March 4, 2024; time approximate: not reported; location 3600 block of Hackett Avenue, Long Beach, CA; premises type residence.
A patrol unit responded to a reported burglary at a residence in the 3600 block of Hackett Avenue, Long Beach, CA.

Suspect posed as a salesman or service worker, knocked, and entered when the occupants did not appear to be home. The report states police give this same account for every incident in the series and that it is not specific to this address, so it is not recorded as this incident's entry method.
Lists time of day, items taken at this address, loss value, entry force, and surveillance or doorbell footage as unknown.
